<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"><meta name="theme-color" content="#0b1539"><link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,"><title>BLOCK FACE · V31 · Friends en Directo</title><style>:root {
  font-family:'Poppins','Trebuchet MS','Arial Rounded MT Bold',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --ink:#13172d;--yellow:#ffe12b;--cream:#fffdfa;--outline:#181a32;--pink:#f53f76;--cyan:#0fc9eb;
  color:var(--ink);font-synthesis:none;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body,#app{margin:0;width:100%;min-height:100%;}
body{background:#10204b;overflow-x:hidden}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed}
button:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #11b7f5;outline-offset:4px;z-index:5}
.visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;height:1px;width:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.screen{width:100%;min-height:100dvh;height:100dvh;position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.menu-screen{display:grid;place-items:center;background:#0a1a38;overflow:hidden}
.menu-stage{position:relative;width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh * 1672 / 941));max-height:100dvh;aspect-ratio:1672 / 941;background-image:var(--menu-image);background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #151527}
/* V10: La portada es una ilustración aprobada con botones dibujados dentro del fondo.
   Estos hotspots son transparentes y sus efectos iluminan los botones existentes,
   sin duplicar su texto ni alterar la ilustración ni la geometría clicable. */
.menu-hotspot{
  --menu-halo:rgba(255,220,106,.55);
  --menu-glow:rgba(255,210,64,.34);
  position:absolute;isolation:isolate;z-index:1;
  background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:100px;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.menu-hotspot::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:3% 2%;border-radius:inherit;
  pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:scale(.975);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.045) 75%,transparent);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--menu-halo),0 0 16px 5px var(--menu-glow),inset 0 2px 7px rgba(255,255,255,.13);
  transition:opacity .18s ease-out,transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}
.menu-hotspot::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:16%;bottom:16%;left:-22%;width:24%;
  border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.50),transparent);
  filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:skewX(-20deg);
}
.menu-hotspot:hover::before,.menu-hotspot:focus-visible::before{
  opacity:1;transform:scale(1.018);
  animation:menu-soft-pulse 1.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
.menu-hotspot:hover::after,.menu-hotspot:focus-visible::after{
  opacity:1;animation:menu-shine .82s cubic-bezier(.25,.65,.35,1) both;
}
.menu-hotspot:active::before{transform:scale(.975);filter:brightness(1.08)}
/* El foco del teclado sigue siendo distinguible; el mouse no produce un aro blanco. */
.menu-hotspot:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #56d8ff;outline-offset:3px}
.menu-play{left:38.8%;top:73%;width:20.9%;height:11.3%;--menu-halo:rgba(255,211,78,.57);--menu-glow:rgba(255,201,48,.42)}
.menu-settings{left:35.75%;top:85.7%;width:12.9%;height:8%;--menu-halo:rgba(113,224,255,.67);--menu-glow:rgba(34,211,245,.44)}
.menu-about{left:49.9%;top:85.7%;width:13.15%;height:8%;--menu-halo:rgba(255,218,139,.55);--menu-glow:rgba(255,211,127,.39)}
@keyframes menu-soft-pulse{from{filter:brightness(.92)}to{filter:brightness(1.16)}}
@keyframes menu-shine{from{left:-22%;opacity:0}15%{opacity:.9}to{left:103%;opacity:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .menu-hotspot::before{transition:none}
 .menu-hotspot:hover::before,.menu-hotspot:focus-visible::before{animation:none;transform:none}
 .menu-hotspot:hover::after,.menu-hotspot:focus-visible::after{animation:none;opacity:0}
}
.dialog-scrim[hidden]{display:none}
.dialog-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;background:#071632bb;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px}
.menu-dialog{position:relative;width:min(470px,90vw);padding:34px 30px;background:var(--cream);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:7px 8px 0 #131934;max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;text-align:center}
.menu-dialog h2{font-size:clamp(21px,3vw,29px);margin:0 0 18px;font-weight:1000}.dialog-inner p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.dialog-close{position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;width:37px;height:37px;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;background:#f7cf61;font-weight:900;font-size:23px}
.scenic-screen{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(10px,2.2dvh,28px) clamp(12px,2vw,36px);background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(9,16,40,.36),rgba(12,15,39,.13) 28%,rgba(12,15,39,.13) 72%,rgba(9,16,40,.36)),url("data:image/webp;base64,");background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.welcome-card{width:min(782px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:clamp(13px,2vh,22px);padding:clamp(22px,3.4vh,42px) clamp(24px,4vw,52px);background:rgba(255,253,247,.97);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:28px;box-shadow:8px 10px 0 rgba(13,19,50,.85),0 20px 45px #091c4470;text-align:center}
.welcome-eyebrow{font-size:clamp(12px,1.7dvh,16px);letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:1000;color:#7b43c8;margin:0}
.welcome-card h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.2vw,49px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0}
.welcome-card h1 span{color:var(--pink)}
.welcome-rule{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;color:#f49d31;font-size:24px;width:48%;justify-content:center;line-height:1}
.welcome-rule span{flex:1;background:#f0d5af;height:2px}
.welcome-story{font-size:clamp(15px,1.45vw,19px);line-height:1.55;max-width:640px;margin:0}
.welcome-before{padding:16px 0 3px;border-top:1px solid #e9ddcd;width:100%;}
.welcome-before strong{font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,21px)}
.welcome-before p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,17px);line-height:1.4;margin:8px 0 0;color:#48516b}
.button-primary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe949,#ffd916);border:3px solid #171c35;border-radius:999px;color:#151830;font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,20px);font-weight:1000;min-height:52px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #161932;transition:transform .12s ease,filter .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease}
.button-primary:not(:disabled):hover{filter:brightness(1.035);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.button-primary:not(:disabled):active{box-shadow:0 1px 0 #161932;transform:translateY(3px)}
.button-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;background:#e1dfd5;filter:grayscale(.4);box-shadow:none}
.button-primary>span{font-size:1.3em;line-height:1}
.welcome-button{width:min(440px,100%);margin-top:5px;flex-shrink:0}
.diagnostic-screen{overflow:hidden}
.diagnostic-shell{width:min(914px,100%);height:auto;max-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;background:rgba(255,253,248,.99);border:3px solid #14192d;border-radius:25px;box-shadow:7px 9px 0 rgba(15,19,50,.91),0 14px 45px #04122a55;overflow:hidden}
.progress-indicator{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:clamp(13px,2vh,19px) clamp(17px,2.8vw,30px);border-bottom:1px solid #e8e5dd;flex-shrink:0;background:#fffdf9}
.progress-title{font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(15px,1.6vw,20px);white-space:nowrap}
.progress-track{height:9px;border-radius:99px;background:#eee4df;overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-width:10px}
.progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fb5a83,#ed3281);transition:width .25s ease}
.progress-number{font-size:23px;white-space:nowrap;color:#181b32}.progress-number span{color:#9b9da8;font-size:.7em;margin-left:5px}
.diagnostic-body{min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;flex:0 1 auto;padding:clamp(12px,2vh,20px) clamp(17px,2.8vw,30px) 0;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#a8a2bc transparent}
.publication{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(7px,1.2vh,11px);width:100%}
.publication-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:50px}
.source-avatar{height:47px;width:47px;min-width:47px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--avatar-color);border:2px solid var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #1a1c3b}
.source-copy{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.source-name{font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,20px);line-height:1.15;font-weight:1000;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.source-meta{font-size:clamp(11px,1.15vw,13px);color:#6b7187}
.source-more{align-self:flex-start;font-size:29px;line-height:1;color:#707a94}
.publication-title{font-size:clamp(17px,2.45vh,23px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.17;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0;color:#17213f}
.publication-art{width:100%;height:clamp(145px,29dvh,248px);border:1px solid #d1d7d8;border-radius:13px;object-fit:contain;background:#e4f4f3;display:block;user-select:none}
.publication-engagement{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 2px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #e3dfdd;color:#69748a;font-size:clamp(12px,1.35vw,15px);font-weight:800}
.publication-engagement span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.publication-engagement svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:#687995;stroke-width:2;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.diagnostic-footer{border-top:0;padding:clamp(20px,2.3dvh,24px) clamp(17px,2.8vw,30px) clamp(15px,2vh,22px);flex-shrink:0;background:#fffdf9;box-shadow:none}
.trust-fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:0;min-width:0;text-align:center}
.trust-fieldset legend{display:block;width:100%;padding:0;margin:0 0 clamp(8px,1.2vh,13px);font-size:clamp(16px,1.65vw,20px);line-height:1.25;font-weight:1000;color:#17213f;text-align:center}
.trust-options{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;max-width:490px;margin:auto}
.trust-rating{height:clamp(42px,6.1vh,55px);width:clamp(42px,6.1vh,55px);border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid white;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #c4c2c2,0 0 0 2px transparent;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,25px);font-weight:1000;color:#fff;transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease}
.trust-1{background:#fc3a61}.trust-2{background:#ff9540}.trust-3{background:#ffd51c;color:#14243a}.trust-4{background:#5fc975;color:#14243a}.trust-5{background:#06a779}
.trust-rating:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-3px)}
.trust-rating.is-selected{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.045);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #141b37,0 4px 0 #141b37}
.trust-extremes{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:7px auto 0;max-width:490px;color:#5d6580;font-size:clamp(11px,1.15vw,13px);font-weight:800}
.completion-status{min-height:0;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,14px);font-weight:800;color:#23644d;margin-top:8px}
.completion-status:empty{display:none}
@media(max-height:760px){
 .diagnostic-body{padding-top:10px}
 .publication{gap:6px}
 .publication-author{min-height:40px}
 .source-avatar{height:40px;width:40px;min-width:40px;font-size:23px;border-radius:12px}
 .publication-art{height:clamp(125px,26dvh,200px)}
 .publication-engagement{padding-bottom:5px}
 .diagnostic-footer{padding-top:20px;padding-bottom:12px}
 .welcome-card{gap:12px;padding-top:23px;padding-bottom:21px}
 .welcome-card h1{font-size:clamp(27px,3.8vw,42px)}
}
@media(max-height:620px){
 .diagnostic-body{padding-top:7px}
 .publication-art{height:clamp(80px,20dvh,125px)}
 .progress-indicator{padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px}
 .publication-title{font-size:16px}
 .trust-rating{height:39px;width:39px}
 .trust-fieldset legend{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px}
 .welcome-card{padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:18px}
 .welcome-story{font-size:15px}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
 .screen:not(.menu-screen){height:auto;min-height:100dvh}
 .scenic-screen{padding:12px;align-items:flex-start}
 .diagnostic-shell{width:100%;height:auto;min-height:0;max-height:none}
 .diagnostic-body{overflow:visible;flex:initial}
 .publication-title{font-size:16px}
 .publication-art{height:auto;aspect-ratio:800/330}
 .diagnostic-footer{margin-top:0}
 .progress-indicator{gap:10px}
 .progress-title{font-size:14px}
 .source-name{font-size:15px}
 .source-meta{font-size:11px}
 .welcome-card{margin:auto;width:100%;max-height:none;overflow:visible}
 .welcome-card h1{font-size:clamp(26px,5.6vw,35px)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

/* Nueva incorporación: dos ventanas sobre el menú, sin modificar su imagen ni hotspots. */
.onboarding-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(6,14,37,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(5px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:clamp(10px,2.5vw,24px)}
.onboarding-dialog{color:#171b32;position:relative;width:min(540px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:clamp(18px,2.8dvh,30px) clamp(18px,3vw,32px);border:3px solid #171b32;border-radius:26px;background:#fffdf9;box-shadow:8px 9px 0 #11172f,0 28px 65px #030b26ac;text-align:center;scrollbar-width:thin}
.onboarding-dialog h2{font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,33px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 10px}
.onboarding-mark{margin:0 auto 9px;display:grid;place-items:center;height:39px;width:39px;background:#ecd9ff;border-radius:50%;font-size:24px;color:#7853bc;border:2px solid #171b32}
.consent-copy{text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-word;hyphens:auto;-webkit-hyphens:auto;font-size:clamp(13px,1.25vw,14.5px);line-height:1.5;color:#41465d}
.consent-copy p{margin:8px 0}
.consent-checkbox{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;border:2px solid #dcd4e9;background:#f4effe;border-radius:13px;padding:12px;margin:15px 0;color:#252443;text-align:left;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.35;cursor:pointer}
.consent-checkbox input{width:20px;height:20px;margin:0;flex-shrink:0;accent-color:#7358d1;cursor:pointer}
.onboarding-actions{display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.onboarding-btn{flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:240px;min-height:47px;padding:10px 11px;border:2.5px solid #191c37;border-radius:14px;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(12.5px,1.3vw,15px);line-height:1.1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #171b35;transition:transform .12s ease,filter .12s ease}
.onboarding-btn:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.03)}
.onboarding-btn:disabled{opacity:.46;box-shadow:none;background:#e8e8e8}
.button-confirm{background:#ffe02f;color:#171b35}.button-outline{background:#fff;color:#25233e}
.identity-dialog{width:min(490px,100%);padding-top:32px;padding-bottom:32px}
.identity-subtitle{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;color:#575b78;max-width:390px;margin:0 auto 18px}
.avatar-bubble{height:clamp(112px,17dvh,152px);width:clamp(112px,17dvh,152px);border:4px solid #9173d3;background:#e9dafe;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 15px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #f2eaff}
.avatar-bubble svg{width:75%;height:75%}
.identity-label{letter-spacing:.11em;color:#6b617f;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000}
.identity-id-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin:5px 0 23px;min-width:0}
.identity-display{display:block;margin:0;color:#29244e;font-size:clamp(25px,3.6vw,35px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.2;overflow-wrap:anywhere;min-width:0}
.identity-regenerate{width:40px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:#7151b1;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease,transform .15s ease}
.identity-regenerate:hover{background:#eee4ff;color:#51308e;transform:rotate(35deg)}
.identity-regenerate:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #7a59cc;outline-offset:3px;background:#eee4ff}
.identity-regenerate .action-icon{width:24px;height:24px}
.identity-confirm-row{display:flex;justify-content:center}
.identity-confirm-row .onboarding-btn{flex:0 1 240px;min-height:52px}
.action-icon{height:17px;width:17px;flex-shrink:0}
.completion-status[data-status="error"]{color:#af3146}.completion-status[data-status="pending"]{color:#5c5085}
.retry-save-btn{display:inline-flex;margin:9px auto 0;padding:8px 18px;font-size:13px;border:2px solid #1b1b35;border-radius:10px;background:#ffe02f;font-weight:950}
@media(max-height:620px){.onboarding-dialog{padding-top:13px;padding-bottom:14px}.onboarding-mark{display:none}.consent-copy{font-size:12.3px;line-height:1.38}.consent-copy p{margin:6px 0}.consent-checkbox{padding:8px;margin:10px 0}.avatar-bubble{margin-bottom:10px}.identity-id-row{margin-bottom:13px}}
@media(max-width:360px){.onboarding-actions{gap:5px}.onboarding-btn{padding:8px 5px;font-size:11px}}


/* Introducción neutral anterior al diagnóstico y narrativa posterior al guardado. */
.diagnostic-intro-card{width:min(735px,100%);gap:clamp(13px,2vh,22px)}
.diagnostic-intro-card h1{font-size:clamp(29px,4vw,46px)}
.intro-instruction{font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,18px);line-height:1.45;color:#48516b;margin:0}
.friends-story-card{gap:clamp(13px,2vh,20px)}
.friends-story-card .welcome-story strong{font-weight:1000}
.chapter-unavailable{font-size:clamp(12px,1.15vw,14px);color:#60657d;margin:-5px 0 0}
.friends-story-card .welcome-button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.82;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe949,#ffd916);filter:saturate(.82);color:#151830;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #161932}
@media(max-height:620px){.diagnostic-intro-card,.friends-story-card{gap:10px}.friends-story-card .welcome-story{line-height:1.35}}

/* Tras completar el diagnóstico, Friends cambia al fondo rosado y celeste aprobado. */
.friends-story-screen{
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(126deg,transparent 0 57px,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 57px 101px,transparent 101px 154px),linear-gradient(108deg,#ff7dab 0%,#f8a2cc 28%,#e0b5eb 48%,#9ccaf8 66%,#64b8fa 100%);
}

/* BLOCK FACE · Capítulo 1 (flujo jugable de referencia). La portada y el diagnóstico permanecen intactos. */
.chapter-screen{min-height:100dvh;height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;color:#0b1d4e;background:
  repeating-linear-gradient(126deg,transparent 0 57px,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 57px 101px,transparent 101px 154px),
  linear-gradient(108deg,#ff7dab 0%,#f8a2cc 28%,#e0b5eb 48%,#9ccaf8 66%,#64b8fa 100%)}
.chapter-frame{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(10px,2dvh,22px);padding:clamp(10px,2.5dvh,30px) clamp(12px,2.5vw,36px) clamp(12px,2.5dvh,28px)}
.chapter-status{z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(165px,1.4fr) minmax(135px,1fr) minmax(135px,1fr) minmax(250px,1.8fr) 45px;align-items:center;gap:clamp(8px,1.6vw,23px);width:min(1350px,100%);min-height:clamp(76px,10.5dvh,100px);margin:0 auto;padding:8px clamp(12px,2vw,28px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:3px solid #101a47;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 7px 0 rgba(29,40,105,.21),0 8px 35px #0a20592f}
.chapter-profile{display:flex;min-width:0;align-items:center;gap:10px}.chapter-profile-avatar{display:block;width:clamp(45px,5.5vw,63px);height:clamp(45px,5.5vw,63px);flex-shrink:0}.chapter-profile-avatar svg{width:100%;height:100%}.chapter-display-name{font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,22px);font-weight:1000;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.1}
.chapter-stat{border-left:2px solid #d4d5ed;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding-left:clamp(7px,1.4vw,22px);min-width:0}
.chapter-stat small,.chapter-cred small{display:block;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,15px);font-weight:850;line-height:1.25;white-space:nowrap}
.chapter-stat strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(18px,2.1vw,27px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.25}
.chapter-stat-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0}.chapter-stat-icon svg{width:clamp(24px,2.5vw,35px);height:clamp(24px,2.5vw,35px)}.pink-icon{color:#f13d83}.blue-icon{color:#2187e7}.yellow-icon{color:#f3bd18}
.chapter-cred{border-left:2px solid #d4d5ed;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(7px,1vw,13px);padding-left:clamp(8px,1.5vw,22px);min-width:0}.chapter-cred .cred-middle{min-width:0;flex:1}.chapter-cred strong{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,26px);font-weight:1000}.cred-track{width:100%;height:clamp(13px,2dvh,21px);margin-top:7px;border:2px solid #11183b;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;background:#c9cce2}.cred-track span{height:100%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe457,#ffc925);border-right:2px solid #e6a900;border-radius:20px}
.chapter-help-icon{width:39px;height:39px;background:#e8eaf8;border:none;color:#7d85a6;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%}.chapter-help-icon:hover{background:#dfe4ff;color:#172750}
.chapter-ticker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:10px clamp(14px,2vw,25px);width:min(1270px,100%);margin:0 auto;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border:2px solid #243465;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #26366524;font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,15px);font-weight:750;line-height:1.3;min-height:46px}.ticker-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:#e93a75;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:1000}.ticker-pill svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.chapter-content{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:0;flex:1;width:100%}
.chapter-card{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(10px,1.8dvh,19px);width:min(1060px,78vw);max-height:100%;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#c5c1e6 transparent;background:rgba(255,254,255,.97);border:4px solid #102051;border-radius:35px;box-shadow:0 9px 0 #23346d38;padding:clamp(21px,3.1dvh,39px) clamp(22px,3.3vw,53px)}
.chapter-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,16px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;background:#122b68;color:#fff;padding:7px 17px;border-radius:100px;margin:0}
.chapter-card h1{color:#071b4c;margin:0;font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,43px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:1000}
.chapter-subtitle{color:#243763;margin:0;font-size:clamp(15px,1.6vw,21px);line-height:1.46}
.chapter-question{text-align:center;color:#112653;font-size:clamp(17px,1.8vw,22px);font-weight:950;margin:0}
.chapter-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:clamp(3px,1dvh,9px)}
.chapter-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:clamp(49px,6.5dvh,66px);min-width:min(280px,100%);padding:10px 27px;border:3px solid #14193c;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #152043;background:linear-gradient(#ffe95d,#ffcf22);color:#09183e;font-size:clamp(15px,1.6vw,20px);font-weight:1000;text-align:center;transition:transform .12s ease}.chapter-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.chapter-btn:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #152043}
.chapter-btn-light{background:#fff;color:#14224d}.chapter-howto{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.chapter-howto>div{background:#f3f0ff;border:2px solid #e5ddfb;border-radius:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:15px 12px}.howto-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0}.howto-icon svg{width:28px;height:28px}.chapter-howto p{margin:0}.chapter-howto strong,.chapter-howto small{display:block}.chapter-howto strong{font-size:14px}.chapter-howto small{font-size:12px;color:#5b6285;line-height:1.35;margin-top:3px}.chapter-tip{margin:0;text-align:center;color:#3c4b73;font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,15px);font-weight:760}
.chapter-news-list{display:grid;gap:12px}.chapter-news-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;background:#f8f8ff;border:2px solid #ccd2f3;color:#132756;border-radius:20px;text-align:left;padding:clamp(12px,1.7dvh,18px);width:100%;transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,transform .15s ease}.chapter-news-option:hover{background:#f3eafa;border-color:#9276d1;transform:translateY(-2px)}.chapter-news-icon{width:58px;height:58px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:15px;color:#f13c7a;background:#fee2ed;flex-shrink:0}.chapter-news-option:nth-child(2) .chapter-news-icon{background:#e1f0ff;color:#2384da}.chapter-news-icon svg{width:30px;height:30px}.chapter-news-option strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(15px,1.6vw,20px);line-height:1.22}.chapter-news-option small{display:block;color:#586789;font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,15px);line-height:1.35;margin-top:6px}.choice-chevron{margin-left:auto;font-weight:950;color:#5464a4;font-size:37px}.chapter-small-note{font-size:clamp(11px,1.12vw,13px);color:#5f6987;line-height:1.35;margin:0}
.chapter-bubbles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.chapter-dialogue-row{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start}.chapter-speaker-dot{width:37px;height:37px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;background:#b4c6fc;color:#101c54;font-weight:1000}.chapter-dialogue-row.red .chapter-speaker-dot{background:#ff3b7d;color:#fff}.chapter-dialogue-row.blue .chapter-speaker-dot{background:#31b9f2;color:#072457}.chapter-dialogue-row.player .chapter-speaker-dot{background:#9568d8;color:#fff}.chapter-dialogue-row.news .chapter-speaker-dot{background:#ffde46;color:#0e2658}.chapter-dialogue-bubble{flex:1;padding:11px 16px;background:#f1f3ff;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #e1e4f6}.chapter-dialogue-row.red .chapter-dialogue-bubble{background:#fff1f6}.chapter-dialogue-row.blue .chapter-dialogue-bubble{background:#ecf8ff}.chapter-dialogue-row.player .chapter-dialogue-bubble{background:#f4edff}.chapter-dialogue-bubble strong{font-size:13px}.chapter-dialogue-bubble p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,16px);line-height:1.35}
.chapter-impact{padding:clamp(14px,2vw,23px);border:2px solid #dcdbf2;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff0f6,#f1f4ff)}.chapter-impact strong{font-size:17px}.chapter-impact p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.5vw,19px);line-height:1.5;margin:7px 0 0}.chapter-impact.reflection{background:#f2edff}.chapter-impact-stats,.chapter-mini-stats{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#273c69;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.chapter-impact-stats svg,.chapter-mini-stats svg{width:18px;height:18px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.chapter-card{width:min(900px,86vw)}.chapter-status{grid-template-columns:minmax(155px,1.1fr) minmax(95px,.8fr) minmax(100px,.8fr) minmax(185px,1.5fr) 35px;gap:6px}.chapter-stat-icon{width:30px}.chapter-stat{gap:5px}.chapter-cred{gap:5px}}
@media(max-width:760px){.chapter-frame{gap:8px;padding:10px 10px 16px}.chapter-status{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:24px}.chapter-profile{grid-column:1}.chapter-stat{border:none;padding-left:0}.chapter-cred{grid-column:1 / -1;border-top:1px solid #d5d6eb;border-left:none;padding:7px 0 0}.chapter-help-icon{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;justify-self:end}.chapter-status{min-height:0}.chapter-stat small,.chapter-cred small{font-size:12px}.chapter-ticker{font-size:11px;gap:8px;padding:7px}.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill{font-size:10px}.chapter-card{width:100%;max-height:100%;padding:18px;border-radius:21px}.chapter-card h1{font-size:clamp(23px,5vw,32px)}.chapter-howto{grid-template-columns:1fr}.chapter-content{min-height:0}.chapter-screen{height:100dvh}.two-actions{flex-direction:column}.chapter-btn{width:100%;min-width:0}.chapter-news-icon{width:46px;height:46px}}
@media(max-height:720px) and (min-width:761px){.chapter-frame{gap:8px;padding-block:8px}.chapter-status{min-height:72px}.chapter-card{padding-block:17px;gap:10px}.chapter-card h1{font-size:clamp(24px,2.6vw,36px)}.chapter-subtitle{font-size:clamp(14px,1.4vw,18px)}.chapter-news-option{padding:11px}.chapter-btn{min-height:47px}.chapter-dialogue-bubble{padding:8px 12px}}

/* V6: introduce el capítulo sin imágenes laterales redundantes ni textos extensos. */
.chapter-intro-card{
  width:min(910px,calc(100% - 36px));
  gap:clamp(14px,2.3dvh,22px);
  padding:clamp(25px,4.8dvh,50px) clamp(28px,5vw,65px);
  align-items:center;
  text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(255,255,255,.99) 0%,rgba(255,253,255,.99) 58%,rgba(249,246,255,.99) 100%);
}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-eyebrow{align-self:center;letter-spacing:.11em;padding:8px 23px}
.chapter-intro-card h1{font-size:clamp(30px,3.65vw,51px);line-height:1.12;max-width:810px;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.chapter-intro-highlight{color:#ed397d}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-subtitle{font-size:clamp(16px,1.65vw,21px);line-height:1.48;max-width:710px;text-wrap:pretty}
.chapter-intro-prompt{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;max-width:100%;color:#13275b;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(17px,1.95vw,24px);padding-top:clamp(1px,1dvh,8px)}
.intro-prompt-spark{color:#ffb52a;font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,26px);flex-shrink:0}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-actions{width:100%;gap:14px;margin-top:0}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn{min-width:0;width:min(292px,calc(50% - 7px));min-height:clamp(52px,6.7dvh,66px);padding-inline:12px}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn-light{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f4f3ff)}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #8560e7;outline-offset:5px}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .chapter-intro-card{width:100%;padding:clamp(19px,4dvh,32px) clamp(16px,4vw,28px);gap:13px}
 .chapter-intro-card h1{font-size:clamp(23px,5.8vw,34px)}
 .chapter-intro-card .chapter-subtitle{font-size:clamp(14px,3.3vw,17px)}
 .chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn{width:100%;min-height:47px}
}
@media(max-height:720px) and (min-width:761px){
 .chapter-intro-card{padding-block:clamp(15px,3dvh,25px);gap:11px}
 .chapter-intro-card h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.3vw,41px)}
 .chapter-intro-card .chapter-subtitle{font-size:clamp(14px,1.45vw,18px)}
 .chapter-intro-prompt{font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,20px)}
 .chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn{min-height:48px}
}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.chapter-news-option,.chapter-btn{transition:none}}

/* V9 — Identidad divertida: personajes reales Rojos/Celestes, sin coronas ni avatar genérico. */
.identity-dialog{width:min(505px,100%);padding:clamp(19px,3dvh,29px) clamp(18px,3vw,33px) clamp(20px,3dvh,29px);
 background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 7%,#ffe6f0 0,transparent 37%),radial-gradient(circle at 91% 16%,#e3f4ff 0,transparent 34%),#fffdfb;}
.identity-sparkle{font-weight:1000;color:#a16bdd;font-size:22px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:9px;letter-spacing:.23em}
.identity-dialog h2{font-size:clamp(27px,3vw,35px);margin-bottom:9px;color:#171d44}
.identity-subtitle{max-width:405px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,15px);margin-bottom:11px;line-height:1.45}
.identity-avatar-stage{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.avatar-bubble{overflow:hidden;position:relative; width:clamp(149px,22dvh,190px);height:clamp(149px,22dvh,190px); margin:0;
 border:4px solid #8059cf; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe9f2,#e7f2ff);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #efdefd,0 9px 0 #c7b4ec;}
/* Personajes completos dentro del círculo: no se recortan peinados ni accesorios. */
.avatar-bubble img{width:80%;height:80%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;user-select:none;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 1px #27325c15)}
.avatar-decoration{font-size:clamp(19px,3vw,29px);color:#f6b82a;line-height:1}
.avatar-decoration-right{color:#8e79e1}
.identity-label{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.11em;color:#6a6185;margin-top:13px}
.identity-id-row{margin:2px 0 0;gap:7px}
.identity-display{font-size:clamp(27px,3.5vw,35px);color:#22214c}
/* Icono discreto junto al nombre: sin círculo lavanda permanente. */
.identity-regenerate{height:38px;width:38px;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:12px;color:#7250bd;box-shadow:none;transition:background .15s ease,transform .18s ease,color .15s ease}
.identity-regenerate:hover{background:#eee7ff;color:#513091;transform:rotate(35deg)}
.identity-regenerate:active{transform:rotate(65deg) scale(.94)}
.identity-regenerate .action-icon{width:22px;height:22px}
.identity-mini-tip{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.25;color:#67618c;margin:3px 0 16px}
.identity-confirm-row .onboarding-btn{flex:0 1 255px;min-height:52px;font-size:16px}
.avatar-pop{animation:avatar-bounce .24s ease-out}
@keyframes avatar-bounce{0%{transform:scale(.85) rotate(-8deg);opacity:.55}75%{transform:scale(1.05) rotate(2deg)}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.chapter-profile-avatar{border:2px solid #1c2753;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#ffedf1,#e1efff);border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center}
.chapter-profile-avatar img{width:84%;height:84%;object-fit:contain}
@media(max-height:650px){.identity-dialog{padding-block:13px}.identity-sparkle{margin-bottom:2px}.identity-subtitle{margin-bottom:8px}.identity-label{margin-top:5px}.avatar-bubble{width:clamp(106px,20dvh,150px);height:clamp(106px,20dvh,150px)}.identity-mini-tip{margin-bottom:8px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.avatar-pop{animation:none!important}}


/* V11 — Titulares de Friends: un cintillo de noticiero en el BORDE superior de la página. */
.chapter-screen{height:auto;min-height:100dvh;overflow:visible;}
.chapter-frame{min-height:100dvh;height:auto;width:100%;padding:0 clamp(10px,2.2vw,28px) clamp(12px,2dvh,24px);gap:clamp(9px,1.8dvh,17px);}
.chapter-ticker{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;flex-shrink:0;width:calc(100% + 2 * clamp(10px,2.2vw,28px));max-width:none;height:46px;min-height:46px;margin:0 calc(-1 * clamp(10px,2.2vw,28px)) 0;padding:0;gap:0;background:#101f50;color:#fff;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid #ffce42;border-radius:0;box-shadow:0 4px 17px #112b5a35;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1;}
.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill{height:100%;z-index:2;position:relative;padding:0 clamp(14px,2vw,27px);font-size:clamp(11px,1.06vw,15px);letter-spacing:.035em;background:#ff397b;color:#fff;gap:10px;box-shadow:5px 0 12px #091c3a30;}
.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill svg{width:19px;height:19px;flex-shrink:0;}
.ticker-live-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff7b5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffffff22;animation:ticker-live 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ticker-window{flex:1;min-width:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.ticker-marquee{display:flex;align-items:center;width:max-content;white-space:nowrap;animation:ticker-travel 20s linear infinite;will-change:transform;}
.ticker-set{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(32px,4vw,70px);flex:none;padding-right:clamp(32px,4vw,70px);}
.ticker-phrase{font-size:clamp(13px,1.25vw,18px);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.018em;}
.ticker-separator{color:#ffe057;font-size:19px;}
.chapter-ticker:hover .ticker-marquee,.chapter-ticker:focus-within .ticker-marquee{animation-play-state:paused;}
@keyframes ticker-travel{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@keyframes ticker-live{50%{opacity:.40;transform:scale(.8)}}
/* Estado superior: SOLO el influencer, seguidores y publicaciones. */
.chapter-status{width:min(1120px,100%);grid-template-columns:minmax(190px,1.5fr) minmax(125px,1fr) minmax(145px,1fr) 48px;gap:clamp(7px,1.5vw,22px);min-height:clamp(72px,10dvh,90px);max-width:100%;margin:0 auto;flex-shrink:0;}
.chapter-status .chapter-profile-avatar img{max-width:84%;max-height:84%;object-fit:contain;}
.chapter-status .chapter-display-name{overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
.chapter-help-icon{grid-column:4;justify-self:end;}
/* Credibilidad independiente: indicador circular animado a la izquierda. */
.chapter-content{flex:1 0 auto;min-height:0;width:100%;padding:clamp(4px,.75dvh,9px) clamp(116px,10.5vw,158px) clamp(8px,2dvh,22px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;}
.chapter-card{flex:0 1 auto;width:min(100%,980px);max-height:none;overflow:visible;}
.chapter-intro-card{width:min(100%,900px);}
.chapter-side-cred{position:absolute;left:clamp(4px,1.6vw,24px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:clamp(88px,8.5vw,118px);z-index:1;color:#11265e;text-align:center;}
.cred-circle{--cred-value:50;width:clamp(70px,7.5vw,104px);aspect-ratio:1;position:relative;border-radius:50%;padding:8px;background:conic-gradient(#fbc430 calc(var(--cred-value) * 1%),#d5d6eb 0);box-shadow:0 6px 0 #1b286442,0 0 0 3px #192858;animation:cred-reveal .55s ease-out both;}
.cred-circle-core{width:100%;height:100%;background:#fffdf8;border:2px solid #f3e6f2;border-radius:50%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;}
.cred-circle-core svg{width:clamp(20px,2.3vw,31px);height:clamp(20px,2.3vw,31px);color:#ffba18;stroke-width:2.4;}
.cred-circle-core strong{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,25px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1.2;}
.cred-side-label{line-height:1.1;font-size:clamp(11px,1.05vw,14px);font-weight:1000;text-wrap:balance;}
.cred-side-label small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#4e5784;margin-top:4px;}
@keyframes cred-reveal{from{opacity:.55;scale:.84}to{opacity:1;scale:1}}
.sound-toggle{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin:10px auto;border:2px solid #151b3f;background:#fff2c2;color:#151b3f;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 18px;font-weight:850;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #141a3d;}
.sound-toggle:hover{filter:brightness(1.04);transform:translateY(-1px);}
/* Pantallas reducidas: los paneles no deben recortarse; se permite scroll vertical real. */
@media(max-width:950px){
 .chapter-frame{gap:8px;}
 .chapter-content{flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;padding:0 6px 16px;gap:10px;}
 .chapter-side-cred{position:static;transform:none;flex-direction:row;justify-content:flex-start;width:auto;align-self:flex-start;padding:0 12px;gap:10px;}
 .cred-circle{width:54px;height:54px;padding:5px;}
 .cred-circle-core svg{width:15px;height:15px;}
 .cred-circle-core strong{font-size:14px;}
 .cred-side-label{font-size:13px;}
 .chapter-card{width:min(100%,820px);}
 .chapter-status{grid-template-columns:minmax(165px,1.4fr) minmax(110px,1fr) minmax(110px,1fr) 38px;}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .chapter-status{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 34px;min-height:0;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:24px;gap:7px;}
 .chapter-profile{grid-column:1 / 3;}
 .chapter-status .chapter-stat{border-top:1px solid #e2e1f1;padding:6px 0 0;}
 .chapter-help-icon{grid-column:3;grid-row:1;}
 .chapter-card{padding:18px;}
 .chapter-ticker{height:44px;min-height:44px;}
 .chapter-ticker .ticker-pill{padding:0 9px;gap:5px;font-size:10px;}
 .chapter-ticker .ticker-pill svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
 .ticker-phrase{font-size:13px;}
}
@media(max-width:480px){.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill span:nth-child(2){display:none}.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill:after{content:'FRIENDS';font-size:11px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .ticker-marquee{animation:none;transform:none;}
 .ticker-live-dot{animation:none;}
 .cred-circle{animation:none;}
 .chapter-ticker:hover .ticker-marquee{animation:none;}
}


/* V15 · Cambio de escenario DESDE el diagnóstico: fondo celeste limpio.
   La portada, el consentimiento y el selector de identidad conservan Friends.
   Las cinco publicaciones y la historia posterior usan el mismo cielo de
   rayas diagonales suaves; sin bandas rosas, destellos ni ilustraciones extras. */
:root{
  --blockface-diagnostic-sky:
    repeating-linear-gradient(128deg,
      rgba(255,255,255,.045) 0 64px,
      rgba(255,255,255,.135) 64px 112px,
      rgba(17,115,211,.055) 112px 164px,
      transparent 164px 212px),
    linear-gradient(115deg,#299af0 0%,#45b0f7 56%,#6bc8f9 100%);
}
.diagnostic-intro-screen,
.diagnostic-screen,
.friends-story-screen,
.chapter-screen{
  background:var(--blockface-diagnostic-sky);
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
}

/* V16 · Escala tipográfica única y HUD compacto aprobado.
   En el capítulo se muestran SOLO Credibilidad (batería), Seguidores y Likes.
   El cintillo es lo primero y permanece arriba; no hay perfil ni progreso 1/4.
   Las cartas usan el espacio disponible: sin scrollbar vertical en escritorio. */
.chapter-screen{
  --type-xs:clamp(11px,1.45dvh,13px);
  --type-sm:clamp(12px,1.75dvh,15px);
  --type-base:clamp(13px,2.0dvh,17px);
  --type-title:clamp(24px,4.0dvh,37px);
  height:100dvh;min-height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;
}
.chapter-frame{
  height:100dvh;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  padding:0 clamp(12px,1.9vw,26px) clamp(7px,1.25dvh,13px);
  gap:clamp(5px,.85dvh,9px);
}
.chapter-ticker{
  position:relative;top:auto;flex:0 0 clamp(34px,5dvh,44px);
  height:clamp(34px,5dvh,44px);min-height:0;
  margin:0 calc(-1 * clamp(12px,1.9vw,26px));
  width:calc(100% + 2 * clamp(12px,1.9vw,26px));
  background:#0d2353;border-bottom:2px solid #0c1d43;
  box-shadow:none;
}
.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill{
  height:100%;background:#ee407b;box-shadow:none;
  font-size:var(--type-xs);letter-spacing:.025em;
  padding-inline:clamp(10px,1.4vw,18px);
}
.chapter-ticker .ticker-pill svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.ticker-phrase{font-size:var(--type-sm);font-weight:650}
.ticker-separator{font-size:15px;color:#adc8e9}
.chapter-status{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(190px,1.6fr) minmax(120px,.85fr) minmax(120px,.85fr);
  gap:clamp(8px,2vw,28px);align-items:center;
  width:min(1040px,100%);max-width:100%;margin:0 auto;
  min-height:0;height:clamp(58px,9.3dvh,78px);flex:0 0 clamp(58px,9.3dvh,78px);
  padding:clamp(5px,1dvh,9px) clamp(10px,1.4vw,18px);
  background:rgba(224,246,255,.13);border:0;border-radius:0;
  box-shadow:none;color:#072958;
}
.chapter-status .chapter-stat{
  border-left:1px solid rgba(11,57,109,.26);
  padding-left:clamp(8px,2.4vw,30px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(7px,1vw,13px)
}
.chapter-stat-icon{width:clamp(23px,3dvh,32px);height:clamp(23px,3dvh,32px)}
.chapter-stat-icon svg{width:clamp(21px,3dvh,29px);height:clamp(21px,3dvh,29px)}
.chapter-stat small{font-size:var(--type-sm);font-weight:800}
.chapter-stat strong{font-size:clamp(18px,3dvh,25px);line-height:1.1}
.chapter-battery-stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-width:0}
.battery-label{font-size:var(--type-sm);font-weight:800;line-height:1.1}
.battery-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(7px,1.3vw,14px)}
.battery-row strong{font-size:clamp(18px,3dvh,25px);font-weight:950;white-space:nowrap}
.battery-case{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:stretch;position:relative;
 padding:4px;border:2px solid #113866;border-radius:5px;
 background:#c5dcf2;flex:1;max-width:225px;min-width:86px;height:clamp(29px,4.3dvh,37px)}
.battery-case::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:100%;top:27%;height:46%;width:5px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:#113866}
.battery-cell{flex:1;border:1px solid rgba(10,52,99,.16);border-radius:2px;
 background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--cell-color) var(--cell-fill),rgba(255,255,255,.45) var(--cell-fill));
 transition:background .35s ease}
.chapter-content{flex:1 1 0;width:min(880px,100%);margin:0 auto;
 padding:0 0 clamp(4px,.75dvh,8px);min-height:0;
 display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.chapter-card,.chapter-intro-card{
 width:100%;max-height:100%;min-height:0;flex:0 1 auto;
 padding:clamp(12px,2.1dvh,24px) clamp(17px,2.4vw,30px);
 gap:clamp(6px,1.15dvh,12px);
 border:2px solid #113565;border-radius:clamp(17px,2.4dvh,25px);
 background:rgba(245,251,255,.94);box-shadow:0 4px 0 #12376825;
 overflow:hidden;
}
.chapter-card h1,.chapter-intro-card h1{font-size:var(--type-title);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.chapter-subtitle,.chapter-intro-card .chapter-subtitle{font-size:var(--type-base);line-height:1.33}
.chapter-eyebrow,.chapter-intro-card .chapter-eyebrow{font-size:var(--type-xs);padding:5px 12px;letter-spacing:.05em;background:#153a73}
.chapter-intro-card{padding:clamp(16px,3dvh,32px) clamp(18px,3.3vw,42px);gap:clamp(9px,1.65dvh,15px)}
.chapter-intro-card h1{font-size:clamp(25px,4.7dvh,45px)}
.chapter-intro-prompt{font-size:clamp(15px,2.3dvh,21px);padding:0}
.intro-prompt-spark{display:none}
.chapter-actions{margin-top:2px;gap:10px}
.chapter-btn,.chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn{min-height:clamp(39px,5.6dvh,50px);font-size:var(--type-base);
 border-width:2px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #14284d;padding:7px 16px}
.chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn{width:min(265px,calc(50% - 5px))}
.chapter-bubbles{gap:clamp(4px,.8dvh,8px)}
.chapter-dialogue-row{gap:clamp(6px,1vw,11px)}
.chapter-speaker-dot{height:clamp(26px,4.2dvh,35px);width:clamp(26px,4.2dvh,35px);font-size:var(--type-sm)}
.chapter-dialogue-bubble{padding:clamp(6px,1dvh,10px) clamp(9px,1.4vw,14px);border-radius:10px}
.chapter-dialogue-bubble strong{font-size:var(--type-xs)}
.chapter-dialogue-bubble p{font-size:var(--type-sm);line-height:1.27;margin:2px 0 0}
.chapter-impact{padding:clamp(8px,1.35dvh,14px);border-width:1px;border-radius:12px}
.chapter-impact strong{font-size:var(--type-sm)}
.chapter-impact p{font-size:var(--type-base);line-height:1.29;margin-top:3px}
.chapter-impact-stats,.chapter-mini-stats{font-size:var(--type-xs);gap:5px}
.chapter-impact-stats svg,.chapter-mini-stats svg{height:14px;width:14px}
.chapter-news-list{gap:clamp(6px,1.15dvh,12px)}
.chapter-news-option{padding:clamp(7px,1.4dvh,12px);border-width:1.5px;border-radius:13px;gap:clamp(7px,1vw,12px)}
.chapter-news-icon{width:clamp(36px,5.8dvh,49px);height:clamp(36px,5.8dvh,49px);border-radius:9px}
.chapter-news-icon svg{width:25px;height:25px}
.chapter-news-option strong{font-size:var(--type-base)}
.chapter-news-option small{font-size:var(--type-sm);line-height:1.25;margin-top:3px}
.choice-chevron{font-size:25px}
.chapter-small-note{font-size:var(--type-xs)}
.chapter-tip{font-size:var(--type-xs)}
.chapter-howto{gap:8px}
.chapter-howto>div{padding:clamp(7px,1.5dvh,12px);border-radius:12px}
.chapter-howto strong{font-size:var(--type-sm)}
.chapter-howto small{font-size:var(--type-xs)}
/* Solo la vista móvil extremadamente estrecha puede requerir desplazamiento.
   En escritorio el contenido se adapta a la altura sin barras de scroll. */
@media(max-width:760px){
 .chapter-status{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;padding:4px 2px;height:70px;flex-basis:70px;gap:5px}
 .chapter-status .chapter-stat{padding-left:6px;gap:4px}
 .battery-case{min-width:52px;gap:2px;padding:3px;height:29px}
 .battery-row{gap:6px}
 .chapter-status .chapter-stat-icon{width:20px}
 .chapter-stat small{white-space:normal;font-size:11px}
 .chapter-content{padding-inline:2px}
 .chapter-card{padding:12px;gap:7px}
 .chapter-howto{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .chapter-btn{width:100%;min-width:0}
 .chapter-intro-card .chapter-actions{flex-direction:row}
 .chapter-intro-card .chapter-btn{width:calc(50% - 5px)}
}
@media(max-height:640px) and (min-width:761px){
 .chapter-frame{gap:4px;padding-bottom:4px}
 .chapter-status{height:50px;flex-basis:50px}
 .chapter-card{padding:9px 16px;gap:5px}
 .chapter-card h1{font-size:clamp(21px,4.1dvh,26px)}
 .chapter-subtitle{font-size:13px}
 .chapter-dialogue-bubble{padding:5px 9px}
 .chapter-dialogue-bubble p{font-size:12px}
 .chapter-impact p{font-size:12px}
 .chapter-btn{min-height:36px}
 .chapter-news-option{padding:6px 9px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.battery-cell{transition:none}}

/* V17 · Un escenario electoral, un solo diálogo glass fijo. No altera el diagnóstico. */
.bf17-screen{--bf-ink:#103568;color:white;background:repeating-linear-gradient(128deg,transparent 0 92px,rgba(255,255,255,.075) 92px 150px,transparent 150px 265px),linear-gradient(116deg,#2694ed,#1587ed 58%,#58c1fa);height:100dvh;min-height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-family:'Poppins','Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif}
/* Noticiero: etiqueta fija, títulos distintos en una franja aislada, un bucle sin saltos. */
.bf17-news-ticker{height:36px;min-height:36px;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;overflow:hidden;background:#102e69;color:#fff;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,14px);letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap}
.bf17-news-ticker>b{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;align-self:stretch;background:#236bc5;padding:0 clamp(11px,1.3vw,17px);font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,12px);letter-spacing:.05em;white-space:nowrap}
.bf17-ticker-viewport{position:relative;min-width:0;flex:1 1 0;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 14px,#000 calc(100% - 14px),transparent 100%)}
.bf17-ticker-track{flex:0 0 auto;width:max-content;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;height:100%;white-space:nowrap;animation:bf17-ticker 57s linear infinite;will-change:transform}
.bf17-ticker-group{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(35px,3.2vw,62px);padding-right:clamp(35px,3.2vw,62px);height:100%}
.bf17-ticker-item{flex:0 0 auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;position:relative;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,15px)}
.bf17-ticker-item:not(:first-child)::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:calc(-1 * clamp(20px,1.6vw,31px));height:13px;border-left:1px solid #8bb9e7}
.bf17-news-ticker:hover .bf17-ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes bf17-ticker{from{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:translate3d(-50%,0,0)}}
.bf17-layout{height:calc(100dvh - 36px);min-height:0;max-width:1720px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(9px,1.55dvh,18px) clamp(12px,2.2vw,38px) clamp(10px,2dvh,20px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2.18fr) minmax(245px,.95fr);gap:clamp(10px,1.3vw,22px)}
.bf17-left{display:grid;grid-template-rows:clamp(63px,11.5dvh,96px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(9px,1.45dvh,18px);min-height:0;min-width:0}
.bf17-hud{min-width:0;height:100%;padding:9px clamp(12px,2.2vw,35px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.52);border-radius:25px;background:rgba(219,243,255,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(13px);box-shadow:0 9px 25px #0b4d9220;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(110px,.8fr) minmax(90px,.8fr);align-items:center}
.bf17-credit{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(8px,1.1vw,17px);min-width:0;justify-content:center;padding-right:clamp(8px,1.7vw,25px);white-space:nowrap}.bf17-credit>span{font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,17px);font-weight:700}.bf17-credit>strong{font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,25px)}
.bf17-battery{position:relative;min-width:62px;max-width:225px;flex:1;height:clamp(20px,3.7dvh,36px);border:2px solid #c9efff;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 8px #074f9e3d;border-radius:8px;display:flex;gap:3px;padding:4px;background:rgba(3,64,134,.46)}
.bf17-battery:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:100%;top:28%;width:5px;height:44%;background:#bde8ff;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.bf17-battery-cell{flex:1;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffe25c var(--fill),rgba(1,92,174,.15) var(--fill));transition:background .28s}
.bf17-stat{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(7px,1vw,16px);height:72%;border-left:1px solid rgba(235,249,255,.56)}.bf17-stat>span:last-child{font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,16px);font-weight:550;line-height:1.1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.bf17-stat strong{font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,30px);line-height:1.1}.bf17-stat svg{width:clamp(25px,3vw,39px);height:clamp(25px,3vw,39px);stroke-width:2.1}.bf17-pink{color:#ff98d5}.bf17-heart{color:#ffe1f4}
.bf17-scene{height:100%;min-height:0;position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(238,250,255,.75);border-radius:clamp(17px,2vw,29px);box-shadow:0 12px 25px #08559a30;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(29,87,180,.37),rgba(26,104,200,.08) 53%,rgba(22,121,227,.43)),url("data:image/webp;base64,") center center/cover no-repeat}
.bf17-scene:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(12,61,150,.48),transparent 37%,transparent 59%,rgba(15,90,177,.25));pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.bf17-scene-heading{position:absolute;z-index:1;top:clamp(16px,2.8dvh,27px);left:clamp(18px,2.8vw,42px);right:12px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #002e6575}.bf17-scene-heading h1{font-size:clamp(23px,3.1vw,42px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 7px;letter-spacing:-.03em}.bf17-scene-heading p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,17px);margin:0;font-weight:550}
.bf17-glass{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:clamp(12px,2.5vw,37px);right:clamp(12px,2.5vw,37px);bottom:clamp(13px,2.6dvh,26px);height:clamp(145px,31dvh,247px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.74);border-radius:clamp(16px,1.7vw,26px);background:rgba(236,246,255,.67);backdrop-filter:blur(15px);box-shadow:0 5px 25px rgba(9,53,128,.17);color:#163867;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(12px,2dvh,23px) clamp(20px,2.4vw,36px)}
.bf17-dialogue-new{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(7px,1dvh,12px);animation:bf17-in .33s ease-out both}.bf17-dialogue-new>p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(14px,1.45vw,22px);line-height:1.4;font-weight:500}.bf17-dialogue-new .bf17-current{font-size:clamp(15px,1.52vw,23px);font-weight:600;text-align:center}.bf17-dialogue-new .bf17-old{font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,15px);text-align:center;color:#7188a4;line-height:1.25;opacity:.8}.bf17-divider{height:1px;background:rgba(74,129,186,.3);flex-shrink:0}
.bf17-dialogue-new .bf17-unmapped{font-size:clamp(11px,.85vw,13px);line-height:1.25;text-align:center;color:#526c8c}
@keyframes bf17-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(17px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.bf17-next{position:absolute;right:clamp(10px,1vw,18px);bottom:clamp(9px,1dvh,17px);display:grid;place-items:center;height:clamp(34px,4.5dvh,47px);width:clamp(34px,4.5dvh,47px);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(48,142,236,.28);border:1px solid #ebf7ff;color:#0c6fca;transition:transform .2s,background .2s}.bf17-next:hover{background:#b2e2ff;transform:translateX(3px)}.bf17-next svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.bf17-options{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(7px,1vw,15px)}.bf17-options button{width:min(44%,290px);min-width:0;min-height:clamp(35px,5dvh,52px);border-radius:13px;padding:7px 10px;background:#1677e4;color:#fff;border:1px solid #b7e6ff;font-size:clamp(13px,1.1vw,17px);font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #0b4b9b;transition:transform .14s,background .14s}.bf17-options button:hover{background:#0862cb;transform:translateY(-2px)}.bf17-options button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.bf17-comments{height:100%;min-height:0;border:1px solid rgba(240,251,255,.67);border-radius:clamp(18px,2vw,29px);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(18,99,195,.24);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 10px 20px #09559b21}
.bf17-comments-header{flex:0 0 clamp(62px,11.5dvh,96px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:7px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(224,248,255,.38);background:rgba(5,72,167,.28);padding:clamp(10px,1.4vw,21px)}.bf17-comments-title{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center;font-size:clamp(14px,1.4vw,19px)}.bf17-comments-title svg{width:27px;height:27px}.bf17-comments-header>span:last-child{font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,14px);white-space:nowrap;color:#dcefff}.bf17-comments-header>span:last-child strong{font-size:17px;color:#fff}
.bf17-comments-empty{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:clamp(16px,2vw,28px);gap:clamp(9px,1.7dvh,18px);color:#fff}.bf17-empty-icon svg{height:clamp(48px,7vw,86px);width:clamp(48px,7vw,86px);stroke:#92d5ff;stroke-width:1.5}.bf17-comments-empty strong{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,21px)}.bf17-comments-empty p{margin:0;max-width:310px;font-size:clamp(12px,1.15vw,16px);line-height:1.5;color:#dbefff}
@media(max-height:675px){.bf17-left{grid-template-rows:59px minmax(0,1fr);gap:7px}.bf17-layout{padding-top:7px;padding-bottom:7px;gap:8px}.bf17-comments-header{flex-basis:59px}.bf17-glass{height:clamp(127px,31dvh,185px);padding:10px 18px}.bf17-dialogue-new>p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,17px)}.bf17-dialogue-new .bf17-current{font-size:clamp(14px,1.35vw,19px)}.bf17-options button{min-height:33px}.bf17-scene-heading{top:14px}.bf17-scene-heading h1{font-size:clamp(21px,2.6vw,29px)}.bf17-scene-heading p{font-size:12px}}
@media(max-width:780px){.bf17-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(170px,.85fr);gap:7px;padding-inline:7px}.bf17-hud{grid-template-columns:1.5fr .75fr .65fr;padding:6px;gap:0;border-radius:15px}.bf17-credit{gap:6px}.bf17-credit>span{font-size:10px}.bf17-credit>strong{font-size:13px}.bf17-stat{gap:3px}.bf17-stat>span:last-child{font-size:10px}.bf17-stat strong{font-size:17px}.bf17-stat svg{height:19px;width:19px}.bf17-battery{min-width:34px;padding:2px;gap:1px}.bf17-comments-header{padding:7px}.bf17-comments-title{font-size:11px;gap:5px}.bf17-comments-title svg{width:17px;height:17px}.bf17-comments-header>span:last-child{font-size:9px}.bf17-glass{left:8px;right:8px;bottom:8px;padding:10px}.bf17-scene-heading{left:11px}.bf17-scene-heading p{max-width:300px}.bf17-dialogue-new>p{font-size:12px}.bf17-options button{font-size:11px}.bf17-comments-empty p{font-size:11px}.bf17-comments-empty strong{font-size:13px}}
@media(max-width:540px){.bf17-screen{height:100dvh}.bf17-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)}.bf17-comments{display:none}.bf17-left{grid-template-rows:60px minmax(0,1fr)}.bf17-scene-heading h1{font-size:26px}.bf17-glass{height:clamp(190px,31dvh,255px)}.bf17-dialogue-new>p{font-size:14px}.bf17-options button{font-size:12px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bf17-news-ticker .bf17-ticker-track,.bf17-dialogue-new{animation:none}.bf17-ticker-group:nth-child(2){display:none}.bf17-next,.bf17-options button{transition:none}}
/* Encadre sin recortar ambos candidatos del recurso de escena. */
.bf17-scene{background-color:#308fdf;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,84,174,.25),rgba(17,104,197,.07) 55%,rgba(36,113,211,.44)),url("data:image/webp;base64,");background-repeat:no-repeat,no-repeat;background-position:center center,center 26%;background-size:cover,100% auto}
/* La imagen electoral empieza arriba del escenario; sin banda azul vacía. */
.bf17-scene{background-position:center center,center top}

/* V19 — escena electoral permanente; solo cambia el contenido del Glass inferior. */
.bf19-choice-scene{height:100%;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(5px,.6dvh,8px);animation:bf17-in .32s ease both}
.bf19-choice-scene h2{font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,24px);line-height:1.05;margin:0;text-align:center;color:#153a6c}
.bf19-choice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);min-height:0;flex:1;gap:clamp(7px,1vw,13px)}
.bf19-choice{min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-between;padding:clamp(5px,.5vw,8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.88);border-radius:clamp(10px,1.15vw,15px);background:rgba(247,250,255,.46);color:#163765;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(3,49,109,.12);transition:background .15s,transform .15s,border-color .15s}
.bf19-choice:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);border-color:#83caff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.bf19-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #063d89;outline-offset:2px}
.bf19-choice-label{flex:0 0 auto;line-height:1.1;font-size:clamp(12px,1.17vw,17px);font-weight:800;text-align:center}
.bf19-choice img{height:0;min-height:0;flex:1;max-width:100%;width:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 48%;border-radius:clamp(6px,.7vw,10px)}
@media(max-height:675px){.bf19-choice-scene h2{font-size:clamp(15px,1.45vw,18px)}.bf19-choice-label{font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,14px)}.bf19-choice{padding:4px;gap:3px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bf19-choice-scene{animation:none}.bf19-choice{transition:none}}

/* V20: al pasar del diálogo a las elecciones ilustradas desaparece la
   escena de candidatos; únicamente permanece una superficie glass central.
   El HUD y el panel de comentarios no cambian. */
.bf17-scene--glass-only {
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(129deg,transparent 0 78px,rgba(255,255,255,.065) 78px 142px,transparent 142px 240px),linear-gradient(125deg,#248de8,#36a2f2 53%,#59baf0) !important;
  background-color:#258fe9;
  background-size:auto,cover !important;
  background-position:center,center !important;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only::before{display:none}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{
  left:clamp(15px,2.4vw,32px);
  right:clamp(15px,2.4vw,32px);
  top:50%;bottom:auto;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
  height:min(76%,570px);
  padding:clamp(13px,2.15vw,27px);
  background:rgba(233,246,255,.26);
  border:1px solid rgba(244,253,255,.65);
  box-shadow:0 9px 26px rgba(8,69,134,.16);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{gap:clamp(12px,2dvh,24px);justify-content:center}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.5vw,32px);color:#083c77}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-grid{gap:clamp(10px,1.4vw,22px);flex:1}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{
  padding:clamp(9px,1.3vw,18px);
  background:rgba(244,250,255,.52);
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  border-radius:18px;
  gap:clamp(7px,1dvh,13px);
  box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(2,49,105,.1)
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-label{font-size:clamp(15px,1.55vw,23px)}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice img{object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px}
@media(max-height:675px){
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{height:82%;padding:10px 14px}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{gap:7px}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene h2{font-size:clamp(18px,2.4vw,24px)}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{padding:7px;gap:5px}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-label{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px)}
}
@media(max-width:780px){
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{left:8px;right:8px;padding:8px; height:83%}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-grid{gap:7px}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{padding:5px;gap:4px;border-radius:10px}
 .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-label{font-size:clamp(12px,1.6vw,17px)}
}
/* Únicamente el panel Glass es visible; el contenedor del escenario no dibuja un segundo cuadro. */
.bf17-scene--glass-only{background:transparent !important;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:none}


/* ================================================================
   V21 — UNA sola superficie Glass de dimensiones FIJAS por escena.
   El contenedor ocupa el mismo rectángulo del escenario en diálogos,
   selección, confirmación y ayuda. Nunca cambia su geometría.
   En la introducción, la ilustración electoral queda detrás del
   mismo vidrio; solo hay un degradado inferior para poder leer.
   No aparecen tarjetas adicionales alrededor del Glass principal.
   ================================================================ */
.bf17-scene,
.bf17-scene--glass-only {
  position:relative;
  height:100%;
  border:0 !important;
  border-radius:clamp(18px,2vw,28px);
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:none !important;
}
